module.title: Bounded polynomial execution: modular intermediates preserve exact in-range results
module.description: Executable multivariate integer polynomials are finite lists of signed coefficients and lists of variable indices. The modular evaluator reduces each multiplication and addition. Structural induction proves residue preservation, then a final nonnegative range bound recovers the exact integer result. An equivalent alternative polynomial can use the same result bound. Intermediate values may be negative or exceed the modulus. This is a standard algebraic fact formalised as a reusable algorithm model, motivated by bounded aggregate caches in a compiler prototype. It is not a Rust, LLVM, finite-map range analysis, transaction, performance or end-to-end compiler proof. No novelty claim.

declarations.name: monomial
declarations.value:
fun env variables =>
  variables.foldr (fun index rest => env index * rest) 1

declarations.name: wordMonomial
declarations.type: ∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int) (variables : List Nat), Int
declarations.value:
fun modulus env variables =>
  variables.foldr (fun index rest => (env index % modulus * rest) % modulus) (1 % modulus)

declarations.name: polynomial
declarations.type: ∀ (env : Nat → Int) (terms : List (Int × List Nat)), Int
declarations.value:
fun env terms =>
  terms.foldr (fun term rest => term.1 * monomial env term.2 + rest) 0

declarations.name: wordPolynomial
declarations.type: ∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int) (terms : List (Int × List Nat)), Int
declarations.value:
fun modulus env terms =>
  terms.foldr (fun term rest => ((term.1 % modulus * wordMonomial modulus env term.2) % modulus + rest) % modulus) 0

declarations.name: monomial_residue
declarations.type: ∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int) (variables : List Nat), wordMonomial modulus env variables = monomial env variables % modulus
declarations.value:
by
  intro modulus env variables
  induction variables with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons index rest ih =>
    simp only [wordMonomial, monomial, List.foldr_cons] at *
    rw [ih]
    simp only [Int.mul_emod, Int.emod_emod]

declarations.name: polynomial_residue
declarations.type: ∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int) (terms : List (Int × List Nat)), wordPolynomial modulus env terms = polynomial env terms % modulus
declarations.value:
by
  intro modulus env terms
  induction terms with
  | nil => simp [wordPolynomial, polynomial]
  | cons term rest ih =>
    simp only [wordPolynomial, polynomial, List.foldr_cons] at *
    rw [ih, monomial_residue]
    simp only [Int.add_emod, Int.mul_emod, Int.emod_emod]

declarations.name: bounded_polynomial
declarations.type:
∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int) (terms : List (Int × List Nat))
    (nonnegative : 0 ≤ polynomial env terms) (fits : polynomial env terms < modulus), wordPolynomial modulus env terms = polynomial env terms
declarations.value:
by
  intro modulus env terms nonnegative fits
  rw [polynomial_residue]
  exact Int.emod_eq_of_lt nonnegative fits

declarations.name: equivalent_bounded_polynomial
declarations.type:
∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int)
    (original alternative : List (Int × List Nat))
    (equivalent : polynomial env original = polynomial env alternative)
    (nonnegative : 0 ≤ polynomial env original) (fits : polynomial env original < modulus), wordPolynomial modulus env alternative = polynomial env original
declarations.value:
by
  intro modulus env original alternative equivalent nonnegative fits
  rw [polynomial_residue, ← equivalent]
  exact Int.emod_eq_of_lt nonnegative fits

source:
import Std
import Batteries
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

namespace Hunch.BoundedPolynomial
def monomial : (∀ (env : Nat → Int) (variables : List Nat), Int) :=
  fun env variables =>
    variables.foldr (fun index rest => env index * rest) 1

def wordMonomial : (∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int) (variables : List Nat), Int) :=
  fun modulus env variables =>
    variables.foldr (fun index rest => (env index % modulus * rest) % modulus) (1 % modulus)

def polynomial : (∀ (env : Nat → Int) (terms : List (Int × List Nat)), Int) :=
  fun env terms =>
    terms.foldr (fun term rest => term.1 * monomial env term.2 + rest) 0

def wordPolynomial : (∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int) (terms : List (Int × List Nat)), Int) :=
  fun modulus env terms =>
    terms.foldr (fun term rest => ((term.1 % modulus * wordMonomial modulus env term.2) % modulus + rest) % modulus) 0

theorem monomial_residue : (∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int) (variables : List Nat), wordMonomial modulus env variables = monomial env variables % modulus) :=
  by
    intro modulus env variables
    induction variables with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons index rest ih =>
      simp only [wordMonomial, monomial, List.foldr_cons] at *
      rw [ih]
      simp only [Int.mul_emod, Int.emod_emod]

theorem polynomial_residue : (∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int) (terms : List (Int × List Nat)), wordPolynomial modulus env terms = polynomial env terms % modulus) :=
  by
    intro modulus env terms
    induction terms with
    | nil => simp [wordPolynomial, polynomial]
    | cons term rest ih =>
      simp only [wordPolynomial, polynomial, List.foldr_cons] at *
      rw [ih, monomial_residue]
      simp only [Int.add_emod, Int.mul_emod, Int.emod_emod]

theorem bounded_polynomial : (∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int) (terms : List (Int × List Nat))
    (nonnegative : 0 ≤ polynomial env terms) (fits : polynomial env terms < modulus), wordPolynomial modulus env terms = polynomial env terms) :=
  by
    intro modulus env terms nonnegative fits
    rw [polynomial_residue]
    exact Int.emod_eq_of_lt nonnegative fits

theorem equivalent_bounded_polynomial : (∀ (modulus : Int) (env : Nat → Int)
    (original alternative : List (Int × List Nat))
    (equivalent : polynomial env original = polynomial env alternative)
    (nonnegative : 0 ≤ polynomial env original) (fits : polynomial env original < modulus), wordPolynomial modulus env alternative = polynomial env original) :=
  by
    intro modulus env original alternative equivalent nonnegative fits
    rw [polynomial_residue, ← equivalent]
    exact Int.emod_eq_of_lt nonnegative fits

end Hunch.BoundedPolynomial

def OA_statement : Prop := (True)

theorem OA_target : OA_statement :=
  by trivial

#print axioms Hunch.BoundedPolynomial.monomial
#print axioms Hunch.BoundedPolynomial.wordMonomial
#print axioms Hunch.BoundedPolynomial.polynomial
#print axioms Hunch.BoundedPolynomial.wordPolynomial
#print axioms Hunch.BoundedPolynomial.monomial_residue
#print axioms Hunch.BoundedPolynomial.polynomial_residue
#print axioms Hunch.BoundedPolynomial.bounded_polynomial
#print axioms Hunch.BoundedPolynomial.equivalent_bounded_polynomial
#print axioms OA_target
#check OA_target
